official_sources.title: GDAL Geometry Validity
official_sources.finding: Invalid geometries can produce incorrect spatial-intersection results; validity should be checked before parcel masking, while validity alone does not detect inter-feature gaps or overlaps.
official_sources.limitation: Validity does not establish parcel authority or coverage correctness.

official_sources.title: gdal vector check-geometry
official_sources.finding: check-geometry tests OGC Simple Features validity and simplicity and can emit invalid-geometry evidence.
official_sources.limitation: A PASS does not prove the source parcel is the intended canonical parcel.

official_sources.title: gdal vector make-valid
official_sources.finding: MakeValid can use linework or structure methods and may remove lower-dimensional components; repair method is part of provenance.
official_sources.limitation: Canonical geometry must not be silently repaired.

official_sources.title: gdal vector check-coverage
official_sources.finding: Coverage validity requires no overlaps, coincident shared-edge nodes and no gaps below the configured width threshold.
official_sources.limitation: Coverage checks assume individually valid polygons and do not establish source authority.

official_sources.title: gdal vector clean-coverage
official_sources.finding: Coverage cleaning changes polygon boundaries through snapping, gap closure and overlap merge strategies.
official_sources.limitation: Cleaning is derived repair and cannot silently alter a canonical boundary.

official_sources.title: gdal vector simplify-coverage
official_sources.finding: Simplify-coverage changes vertices while preserving shared boundaries and does not fix pre-existing gaps or overlaps.
official_sources.limitation: Simplified geometry is not terminal canonical-boundary evidence.

official_sources.title: OGRGeometry class reference
official_sources.finding: OGRGeometry exposes IsValid, IsSimple and GEOS-backed geometry operations; deterministic replay depends on the exact GDAL/GEOS runtime.
official_sources.limitation: API semantics do not freeze the deployed library build.

official_sources.title: gdal vector clip
official_sources.finding: Vector clipping can reproject clip geometry/bounds into the input CRS, split collections and change output geometry typing.
official_sources.limitation: Clipped output is derived and requires digest/topology reconciliation.

official_sources.title: gdal raster clip
official_sources.finding: Raster clip preserves source resolution and snaps bounds to whole pixels; geometry clipping selects overlapping pixels and can fill outside-source areas when explicitly allowed.
official_sources.limitation: Overlap clipping is not automatically the terminal parcel-membership rule.

official_sources.title: gdalwarp
official_sources.finding: Warping exposes cutline CRS, crop-to-cutline, resampling, overview selection, error threshold and target alignment options that can change derived pixel support.
official_sources.limitation: Warped values are derived and must not replace native parcel samples.

official_sources.title: gdal vector rasterize
official_sources.finding: Default rasterization and --all-touched produce different boundary-pixel populations; the membership rule must be explicit.
official_sources.limitation: The canonical geometry and target grid still require execution.

official_sources.title: gdal_rasterize
official_sources.finding: Classic rasterization supports -at and target alignment; edge outcomes can depend on burn order where features overlap.
official_sources.limitation: Feature order and grid alignment must be logged for deterministic reproduction.

official_sources.title: gdal raster polygonize
official_sources.finding: Polygonize creates polygons from connected equal-valued regions, excludes masked/NoData pixels, and changes connectivity when diagonal pixels are connected.
official_sources.limitation: Polygonized geometry is derived QA evidence.

official_sources.title: gdal_polygonize
official_sources.finding: Classic polygonize supports explicit masks and 4/8-connected behavior for independent mask-to-geometry replay.
official_sources.limitation: Connectivity choice changes derived polygons and must be pinned.

official_sources.title: gdal raster pixel-info
official_sources.finding: pixel-info reports input coordinates, converted column/line, unscaled values and contributing VRT files, with explicit resampling.
official_sources.limitation: Interpolation produces derived values and must be separated from native-cell membership.

official_sources.title: gdallocationinfo
official_sources.finding: gdallocationinfo provides an independent coordinate-to-pixel query path with selectable overview and resampling modes.
official_sources.limitation: Overview/resampling must be disabled or pinned for terminal replay.

official_sources.title: gdal raster proximity
official_sources.finding: Raster proximity measures Cartesian distance from each pixel center to the nearest target pixel center, making pixel-center distance semantics explicit.
official_sources.limitation: Proximity is QA, not an elevation or membership source.

official_sources.title: gdal raster pipeline
official_sources.finding: Raster pipeline can chain clipping and calculations; every stage and parameter must be serialized for replay.
official_sources.limitation: Pipeline convenience can conceal derived transformations when provenance is omitted.

official_sources.title: gdal vector pipeline
official_sources.finding: Vector pipeline exposes validation, coverage cleaning and clipping as separate stages, allowing validation and mutation to remain distinguishable.
official_sources.limitation: Validation stages must not be conflated with mutation stages.

official_sources.title: gdal vector buffer
official_sources.finding: A zero-distance buffer can sometimes repair invalid geometry, but GDAL recommends MakeValid for reliable repair; buffer-based repair must not occur silently.
official_sources.limitation: Buffer output is derived and may change topology/type.

candidates.name: Clip CRS and geometry-type preservation chain
